tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Searches the LexOpti developer documentation (guides, SDK, API operations). Returns the best sections with their URL and a snippet.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Reads a page of the documentation as Markdown, or one of its sections (by its heading). A page without French version answers in English, with fallback: true.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: Lists every page of the documentation with its slug, title and description.

tools.name: get_api_operation
tools.description: Reads one operation of the LexOpti API: method and path, parameters, request body schema, responses and errors, and its TypeScript SDK example. An operation without French version answers in English, with fallback: true.
